event.notes: Prospective client from energy sector, Russian national

mission_description: Perform full KYC name screening for new individual customer C003 (Valeria Petrov, RUS national), an energy sector executive from Russia. The customer originates from a FATF high-risk jurisdiction. Verify identity, screen against all applicable UN, OFAC, EU and HKMA sanctions lists, assess adverse media, and make a compliance decision per AMLO requirements.
